1.explanation: This example sets up a Carbon DataTable with 6 batch actions and forces the container down to ~320px wide. On mounting, click any single checkbox (or the Select All) to reveal the blue batch-actions bar. When the bar appears, you will see that the leftmost actions get clipped off and cannot be scrolled into view—exactly reproducing the bug on small screens. You can shrink or expand the wrapper <div> to observe the scroll/clipping behavior.
1.bug_scenario: When selecting one or more rows in a DataTable on a narrow viewport (or when the table container is forced to a small width), the blue batch‐actions bar at the top overflows its container—clipping off the first one or two actions rather than allowing you to scroll horizontally to see all actions. In the screenshot you can see the “Download to” action is partially hidden and cannot be reached.
